newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends firmer, focus on LME spreads.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends firmer, focus on LME spreads.

text.p: COMEX copper settled slightly firmer after a session when the market largely treaded water as it observed the extreme tightness reflected in the cash to three months spread on LME.
"There is a little uncertainty as we are not getting any fresh fund buying that we saw several days ago," Bette Raptopoulos of Prudential Securities said.
Stocks on the London exchange rose 9,650 tonnes on Tuesday to 165,650 tonnes, in line with trader expectations.
With such a strong backwardation in London and an LME spot premium over its COMEX counterpart, it would have been surprising if stocks had not risen, traders said.
"The inventories are shifting and are not from an excess surplus," Raptopoulos said. "I think it (the price) will move higher."
March COMEX fluctuated within a narrow band of just over a cent, settling 0.25 cent firmer at 106.15 cents per pound, traded 106.30 to 105.10 cents.
The LME backwardation was at $329/$333 at the COMEX close, up $15 from Monday as the market pushes through the tight dates on LME which begin Jan 29 through mid-February.
